However, instead of a plain prose summary, it organizes the text into a bulleted list with bold pseudo-field labels, introducing some unrequested structure. This falls short of the completely unstructured prose described in level 5, but does not constitute the heavy incidental structure of level 3, making level 4 the appropriate score.
